# How Points Work

How the TxFlow Points Program measures trading, how each weekly pool is shared out, and what does not earn Points.

> **Key takeaway:** Points are a **share of a weekly pool**, not a fixed reward per trade. **1,250,000 trader Points** are distributed every week among eligible traders, based on the overall quality of their **perpetual** trading. Activity that exists only to farm Points earns fewer Points or none.

## Why Points exist

The TxFlow Points Program exists to reward real traders and support the healthy, long-term growth of the platform. Traders always come first. The trader pool is the largest pool in the program, and activity that only exists to farm Points earns fewer Points or none, which leaves more for genuine traders.

## A fair game for every trader

Points are a share of a weekly pool, so your reward reflects how your trading compares with others that week. Every trader can earn a fair share of the pool:

- **Everyone plays by the same rules.** All trading is measured against the same standards of genuine activity.
- **No one can take the whole pool.** The scoring limits how much the very largest traders can dominate, so the pool stays open to everyone.
- **Every eligible trader counts.** Our scoring is designed to recognize genuine trading across different trading volumes, giving smaller traders a real opportunity to take part.
- **Farming doesn't pay off.** Activity that only exists to collect Points earns fewer Points or none, and those Points stay in the pool for genuine traders.

## How Points are distributed

Season 1 starts on **October 12, 2026**, and weekly distribution will conclude no later than **Q1 2027**. Each week is one epoch, running Monday to Monday (UTC). Points are credited on **Tuesday** after each epoch ends and displayed on your Points dashboard. The first Season 1 drop will happen on **Tuesday, October 20, 2026**. Early activity before Season 1 has been accounted for in the Season 0 points distribution. More details found [here](/points/season-0-points.md).

This weekly Points epoch is unrelated to the consensus epochs reported by [`epochHistory`](/api/info/epochHistory.md).

| Pool | Share | Basis | Amount |
|---|---|---|---|
| Trader | 82% | Weekly | 1,250,000 |
| Referral | 10% | Weekly | 152,000/Cap |
| Growth Reserve | 8% | Monthly | 488,000/Month |

- **1,250,000** trader Points are distributed every week among eligible traders. Your share reflects the overall quality of your trading across multiple factors, with volume as one part of the picture.
- **152,000** Points is the weekly cap for total referral rewards. Referral rewards are 10% of the trader points earned by referred users. Total referral rewards will never exceed this weekly cap, including any future referral campaigns or incentives
- **Growth Reserve** is a monthly budget of **488,000** Points for growth activities. Unused Points roll over to the next month, and any Points still unused at the end of Season 1 are burned. See [Growth Reserve](#growth-reserve) below.

## How to earn Points

Trade perpetual futures on TxFlow. Both maker and taker trades count. Points are based on the overall quality of your trading, including:

- Trading volume
- Open interest (holding real positions)
- Trading activity over time
- Fees paid
- TVL contribution (capital you keep on the platform)
- Referrals

The exact weights and formulas are not published, so the program rewards genuine trading rather than trading aimed at a formula. You need a minimum amount of genuine trading in an epoch to qualify.

### Do Vault deposits earn Points?

Depositing into a Vault alone does not earn Points. To have your Vault contribution factored into your Points for an epoch, you must have eligible trading activity during that epoch.

## Activity that earns no Points

- Spot trading and Prediction Markets (Season 1)
- Orders that are placed but canceled before filling.
- Depositing, withdrawing or holding a position on its own. Your balance and open positions still count toward your score when you're trading.

## Referrals

- Anyone can share a referral code. No application is needed.
- Referrers earn trader Points from their own trading like everyone else, and on top of that earn referral rewards based on their referred users' trading.
- Referral rewards come from a **separate pool of up to 152,000 Points per week**, so they never reduce anyone's trader Points, including the referred user's own.
- Any referral Points not used within a given week are burned at the end of that week. They do not carry over.
- A referral link is set when someone signs up and cannot be changed later.

To get a referral code to share, see [Referral](/trade/referral.md). Referral Points are separate from the fee rebate and fee discount described there.

## Growth Reserve

The Growth Reserve is a monthly budget of 488,000 Points, drawn from the 8% share of the Season 1 budget. It funds growth activities such as community trading campaigns and builder programs. Points not used in a month roll forward to the next month, and any Points still unused at the end of Season 1 are burned.

- **Why monthly, not weekly:** growth activity doesn't follow a weekly cycle, and market conditions can change. We adjust the budget accordingly. A monthly budget gives room to respond without locking Points into weeks where they wouldn't be used.
- **Rollover:** if the monthly budget is not fully used, the remainder rolls forward to the next month.
- **Burn:** any Points still remaining in this pool at the end of the season are burned.
- **Use:** Growth Reserve Points may fund growth activities, including future community trading campaigns and builder programs. Growth Reserve Points will never be used by the TxFlow team for its own benefit.

## Keeping the game fair

Our checks exist to protect genuine traders. We use automated and manual systems to detect Sybil accounts and farming, such as wash trading, deliberately creating multiple accounts (manually or in an automated way) to farm Points systematically, and artificial volume. Activity identified as farming earns fewer Points or none, and those Points go to genuine traders instead.

Our detection is designed to identify abusive activity while minimizing the impact on legitimate traders. The signals we use are not disclosed, so they cannot be worked around. Full details are in the [Points Program Terms](/terms/points-program-terms.md).

## Your Points

- Points stay with the wallet that earned them and cannot be transferred, bought or sold.
- TxFlow never sells Points and does not allow anyone to sell them. Anyone offering to sell Points is running a scam.
- Keep your wallet secure. Points cannot be moved to a new wallet if access to the original wallet is lost.

> **Info:** Points are a measure of your trading contribution to TxFlow. Read the full [Points Program Terms](/terms/points-program-terms.md) for details.

# Points Program Terms

These terms are part of the TxFlow [Terms of Use](https://txflow.com/terms). By taking part in the Points Program, you agree to them. If anything here conflicts with the Terms of Use, the Terms of Use apply.

For a plain-language overview of the program, see [How Points Work](/points/how-points-work.md).

## 1. Who can take part

1.1 The Points Program is open to anyone with an active TxFlow account, subject to the regional and eligibility requirements in the Terms of Use.

1.2 TxFlow-operated accounts are not eligible for Points.

1.3 Testnet or simulated activity, and trading on unsupported or delisted markets (after delisting takes effect), do not earn Points.

## 2. How Points are scored

2.1 Your Points reflect your trading as a whole, not any single action.

2.2 Scoring weights and formulas are proprietary. TxFlow may add, remove or refine scoring factors during or between seasons to keep the program fair.

2.3 Weekly Points are displayed each week on your Points dashboard. If farming is detected later, only the Points linked to that activity can be adjusted, including deductions for wallets flagged for Sybil activity.

2.4 Third-party calculators and community estimates are helpful, but they are not endorsed by TxFlow and do not determine your Points.

## 3. Keeping the game fair

3.1 The following activity takes Points away from genuine traders, so we don't allow it:

- Wash trading or self-matching: trading with yourself or with accounts you control to inflate trading metrics.
- Sybil farming: deliberately creating or operating multiple accounts or wallets, manually or in an automated way, to farm Points systematically.
- Artificial volume: cycling trades with no genuine market intent to inflate volume.
- Referral abuse: fake or inactive referred accounts, signing up under your own referral code (directly or through another wallet you control), or circular referral arrangements.
- Exploiting bugs or unintended behavior to gain Points.
- Getting around integrity checks or risk controls, or trying to reverse-engineer the scoring methodology.
- Market manipulation, such as spoofing or layering.

3.2 These rules apply whether activity happens in one account, across several accounts, or through coordination with other users, and across all assets, pairs and products. Having another trading purpose alongside farming does not change the assessment.

3.3 If several wallets are clearly controlled by the same person or group, we may treat them as one user, so the pool stays fair for everyone else.

3.4 We review activity on an ongoing basis. If farming is found, the Points linked to it, including Points earned by wallets flagged for Sybil activity, may be reduced, withheld or deducted, including retroactively. Repeated or serious farming may lead to exclusion from the Points Program.

3.5 We want to get this right. If you think your eligibility or Points were affected by mistake, contact official TxFlow support and we'll review it.

3.6 Exclusion from the Points Program does not affect your access to the platform. You can keep trading as normal.

## 4. Your Points

4.1 Points are non-transferable and stay with the wallet that earned them. TxFlow will not move Points to another wallet, including after wallet theft, lost private keys or lost access.

4.2 Points measure your contribution to TxFlow. They are not a currency.

4.3 Trading carries real costs and risks. Trade at a pace and size that suits you.

## 5. Changes to the program

5.1 We may refine the program as it grows, including its rules, scoring, pool sizes and schedule. We'll tell you about material changes in advance through official channels.

5.2 If the program ends, we will tell you how accumulated Points will be treated.

## 6. Looking ahead

6.1 Points may be one of the factors considered for any future token distribution. We will announce the details of any such distribution separately, through official TxFlow channels.

6.2 Your Points are a record of your trading contribution. Full details of any future distribution will be shared through official TxFlow channels when they are ready.

## 7. Good to know

7.1 TxFlow makes no promise about the future value of any token that may be connected to the Points Program.

7.2 Taking part in the Points Program is not an investment or a promise of future returns.

7.3 Trading carries risk. TxFlow is not liable for trading losses connected with the Points Program, or for losses from Points adjustments, program changes or exclusion, except where the law requires otherwise.

# Points

The Variational Omni points program is designed to reward users of the Protocol. The program was officially launched on December 17, 2025. Point totals can be tracked by visiting the [Omni points page](https://omni.variational.io/points).

Upon the launch of the program, 3,000,000 points were retroactively distributed to existing traders based on a variety of activity metrics through December 11. Users also received an additional 1 point for every 10 points their referrals earned.

Going forward, points will be distributed every Friday at 0:00 UTC for the previous week’s platform activity through 0:00 UTC on Thursday. Weekly point distributions will conclude no later than the end of Q4 2026 (see [X article](https://x.com/variational_io/status/2102929439063765192) for details).

Users will receive 1 point for every 10 points their referrals earn. Accounts that traded before the launch of the points program will receive a 10% boost to points earned. Users can also receive a boost by maintaining a [reward tier](https://docs.variational.io/omni/rewards) on Omni.

| Tier         | Points Boost |
| ------------ | ------------ |
| **Iron**     | +0%          |
| **Bronze**   | +0.5%        |
| **Silver**   | +1%          |
| **Gold**     | +2%          |
| **Platinum** | +3%          |
| **Diamond**  | +4%          |
| **Infinity** | +5%          |

Variational reserves all rights to modify the points program or point totals at its sole discretion (e.g. for inorganic behavior or any violation of the [Terms of Use](/legal/terms-of-use.md)).
